turns.prompt: Make an original program cover for a riverside poetry reading, using the painting as a mood reference and the woven cloth as a rhythm reference. The words are River Voices, Saturday 16:00, North Quay Reading Room, and Poems, conversation, and a walk along the water. I want openness without the practical details looking lost. Show A with a broad quiet field and B with a more compressed column arrangement, at the same canvas size. The title should lead, followed by time and place, then the explanation. Translate the painting's large-versus-small movement into composition; do not paste or redraw the painting as a background. Keep the original reference-specific explanation separate from your design suggestions. Deliver a.svg, a.png, b.svg, b.png, thumb.svg, thumb.png, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. PNG sizes: 160x160, 960x720.

Choose B for its alignment, not its density. Keep A unchanged. Add Admission free; step-free entrance on the east side and Bring a poem to share. I want the detail block easier to scan, with related information grouped by proximity and spacing rather than boxing every line. Preserve the title size and the accepted column edge. Deliver a.svg, a.png, b.svg, b.png, thumb.svg, thumb.png, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. PNG sizes: 160x160, 960x720.

Now check the design as a 160x160 social preview. The title must still be recognizable and the date/location group must remain distinct, even if the smallest invitation sentence is not fully readable. Change B's contrast and spacing only, keeping its text, title size, and column edge. Deliver the full-sized A/B sheets and the new thumbnail, and state which small text was actually legible. Deliver a.svg, a.png, b.svg, b.png, thumb.svg, thumb.png, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn.
